name: Hex: Face the Darkness

description.content: Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.
Every [25s], other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for [2s].
When the hexed Survivor is downed pr becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.

quote: "I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace." -Tarhos Kovács
